target_customer: RF engineers at spacecraft, drone and cellphone makers and labs
problem: Legacy RF test equipment is expensive and hard to automate; setup time slows hardware teams.
business_model: Hardware sales of networked instruments (attenuator $800, SP4T switch $1,200 listed)

founders.name: Noah Levy
founders.background_notes: YC page: calibrated phased array, Starship RF hardware, Falcon 9 radar altimeter, Dragon 2 S-band

founders.name: Andrew Kurtz
founders.background_notes: YC page: 9 years as aerospace mechanical engineer; launch post says the founders spent a decade at SpaceX but his bio names no employer

competitors.name: Keysight
competitors.traction_then: Dominant incumbent, launched new signal analyzers Jun 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: RF attenuators and switches to 6 GHz with networked firmware and web UIs are hard hardware but not research grade; founders have SpaceX RF experience.

defensibility.rationale: Simple modules are copyable; the software API and rack ecosystem could build some lock-in over time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to tell; incumbents launched new analyzers at IMS 2026 but not matching products.

market_need_then: Company cites a $130B test equipment market; the products target automation and AI agent friendly APIs, shown at IMS 2026 per trade press.

identity.visual_style: Product pages and a touchscreen on each instrument; not described further by a source

branding.brand_signature: Touchscreen driverless modules, skill.md for AI agents

brand_strength.rationale: Plainspoken taglines and trade show presence at IMS 2026 per EverythingRF, but no community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Nine Fives is a Spring 2026 YC company selling shipping RF attenuators and switches and showed them at IMS 2026. Founders come from SpaceX RF work. It is early, with no exit or verified funding. The questions are whether modern networked modules can pry share from Keysight and Rohde & Schwarz.
notes: FundedIQ reports $500K pre-seed in June 2026 and YesPress reports $130K YC seed; unreconciled aggregators, not recorded as rounds. SpaceCapital lists a portfolio page, amount not seen. Team size conflicts (3 in directory, 2 in YC launch). Name origin not found.
